description: Diplo God Mode makes Umbraco 17 developers invincible!
releaseNotes: Adds asynchronous, cached Overview release checks for Umbraco and God Mode, with an EnableReleaseCheck opt-out. Adds Scheduled Publishing, server time zone and UTC diagnostics, a Local / Server / UTC date display switch, and Health & Risk rules for date migration, scheduling and background jobs. Uses the real process start time for uptime and fixes FeaturesToHide in the God Mode tree. See the package README for full 17.3.0 release notes.
title: Diplo.GodMode
